title: 'Likweli': A new monkey species discovered in the Congo Basin
summary: Yale University researchers announce the discovery of a new monkey species named 'Likweli' in the Congo Basin, marking a significant addition to the biodiversity catalog of Central Africa.
problem_solved: It expands our understanding of biodiversity in one of Africa's most biodiverse regions.
why_valuable: The discovery highlights the importance of conservation efforts in the Congo Basin and contributes valuable knowledge to the scientific community about primate diversity.
